pages.text: Every printer has upgrade slots equal to its tier (a Tier 3 printer has 3 slots). Shift+Right Click a module onto the machine to install it, or drop it into an upgrade slot in the GUI:$(br)$(li)$(item)Speed$() — faster printing$(li)$(item)Efficiency$() — less FU per print$(li)$(item)RF Efficiency$() — less power$(li)$(item)Buffer$() — bigger RF tank
$(item)RF Efficiency Upgrade$(): ×0.85 RF cost per module.

pages.title: Stacking
pages.text: Modules stack $(l)multiplicatively$() — two Speed Upgrades make prints 0.8 × 0.8 = $(l)64%$() of the base time, and it never reaches zero.$(br2)Mix and match within a tier's slots. All module rates are exposed in the config for pack makers.
